project_type: Local Windows stdlib web app orchestrating a daily OOJ ticket automation that enriches tracking IDs (TIDs) from 8 Amazon tools. Read-only against Amazon systems, no AI/LLM.
build_system: No build step; pure Python stdlib + openpyxl + playwright. Tests are the gate.
test_framework: mix of unittest (tests/test_polygon_workflow.py) and pytest (tests/test_web_controller.py); all run under pytest.
verification_instructions: From workspace root run `py -3.13 -m pytest tests -q`. Baseline is 64 passed; end state must be >= 64 (expected >= 68 with the new Feature A + Feature B tests). cmd has no `tail`; redirect output to a temp file and read it, then delete the temp file. The shell wrapper prints a noisy banner line but the command still runs — read the redirected file for the real result.
snapshot_or_generated_files: none — no checked-in generated artifacts. Run outputs live under tools/captures/runs/ and are gitignored/pruned; do not commit them.
environment_constraints: Read-only against Amazon systems; no network in tests (all SIW sessions are faked). Do NOT open the single Edge automation profile at preflight (preflight() treats an open profile as a hard error via edge_profile_processes). Do NOT change BATCH_EDGE(200)/BATCH_MCSCLI(500), the one-way mcscli->Edge fallback, /grbi sequential ordering, ADS single-file upload, column removal (stays disabled), or any remark logic. Keep partial mode working exactly as-is.
contribution_requirements: Inclusive language only. Commit messages follow Conventional Commits. Commit locally; never push. Build/verify (run the tests) before each commit.
key_patterns: Fake SIW sessions in tests expose post_json/ensure_ready/transport_name/summary/close (see FakeSiwSession and the per-test fake sessions in tests/test_polygon_workflow.py FailurePathTests). Error statuses use ERROR_PREFIX='Error — '. Web controller wraps risky probes in a *_safe() helper that never raises (see _environment_checklist_safe). gcrs_mcscli.fetch returns (ordered_rows, not_found, errored); 'errored' is for unresolved-but-not-confirmed-invalid TIDs. tid_polygon_checker row-aligns an 'Error — SIW unresolved after degraded/poison guards' status for every errored TID, preserving the polygon row-count contract. patch gcrs_mcscli.time.sleep to make backoff tests instant.
relevant_files: tools/gcrs_mcscli.py (Feature B: BATCH_* constants, _batch_size_for, _resolve, _grbi, fetch loop)
tools/run_daily.py (Feature A: preflight(); also lane_gcrs/lane_polygon/lane_ads show how errored TIDs are consumed and that partial mode continues)
tools/siw_client.py (FailoverSiwSession.ensure_ready/transport_name/summary; TransportError; mode mcscli|auto|edge; the one-way fallback)
tools/tid_polygon_checker.py (run_boundary_check consumes gcrs_result's errored list, row-aligns 'Error — SIW unresolved...' — evidence that Feature B continue-after-degrade is safe)
tests/test_polygon_workflow.py (FakeSiwSession, FailurePathTests style — add Feature B tests here and the run_daily preflight test)
tests/test_web_controller.py (preflight_state / gate tests — add Feature A tests here)
Docs/edge-cases.md (#G8 Failed-to-fetch root cause; #G10/#G11 one-way fallback)
Docs/changes.md (dated change log — add entries here)
directory_structure: tools/ holds the pipeline modules; tools/web/ holds the local web app (server.py + run_controller.py); tests/ holds the suite; Docs/ holds edge-cases.md and changes.md; tools/captures/runs/ holds (gitignored) run artifacts including the 2026-10-04 Failed-to-fetch run that motivated this work; .agents/tasks/ holds this plan and the review verdict file.
